sentences.s: 我们的车配备了空调。
sentences.t: 我們的車配備了空調。
sentences.en: Our car is equipped with air conditioning.

sentences.s: 我无法忍受它了。
sentences.t: 我無法忍受它了。
sentences.en: I can't put up with it.

sentences.s: 在家靠父母，出门靠朋友。
sentences.t: 在家靠父母，出門靠朋友。
sentences.en: At home [you] rely on [your] parents, [when you] go out [you] rely on [your] friends.

source.title: 靠
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 他将要睡觉。
sentences.t: 他將要睡覺。
sentences.en: He'll be asleep.

sentences.s: 一部分的钱被偷走了。
sentences.t: 一部分的錢被偷走了。
sentences.en: Some of the money was stolen.

sentences.s: 你们也太大胆了吧！
sentences.t: 你們也太大膽了吧！
sentences.en: You were also too brave!

sentences.s: 我错过午饭了吗？
sentences.t: 我錯過午飯了嗎？
sentences.en: Have I missed lunch?

sentences.s: 我看到汤姆站靠近窗口。
sentences.t: 我看到湯姆站靠近窗口。
sentences.en: I saw Tom standing near the window.

sentences.s: 开汽车也好，骑自行车也罢，行进中打电话都会影响注意力与反应能力。
sentences.t: 開汽車也好，騎自行車也罷，行進中打電話都會影響注意力與反應能力。
sentences.en: It doesn’t matter whether [you are] driving a car or riding a bicycle, making phone calls during the journey can affect attention and reaction ability.

source.title: CLAUSE1 也好 CLAUSE2 也罢
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我不是被解雇，是自己辞职不干的。
sentences.t: 我不是被解僱，是自己辭職不幹的。
sentences.en: I wasn't fired. I quit.

sentences.s: 我喜欢有很多蔬菜的汤。
sentences.t: 我喜歡有很多蔬菜的湯。
sentences.en: I like soups with lots of vegetables.

sentences.s: 你的时间快用完了。
sentences.t: 你的時間快用完了。
sentences.en: Your time is running out.

sentences.s: 他没拿着铅笔。
sentences.t: 他沒拿着鉛筆。
sentences.en: He’s not holding a pencil.

source.title: 没 V 着 O
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 除了个别人以外，多数人体重的增加会从周六开始。
sentences.t: 除了個別人以外，多數人體重的增加會從週六開始。
sentences.en: Except for a few individual [persons], the weight gain of most people starts on Saturday.

source.title: 个别 N
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 一些分析家认为索马里是非常失败的国家。
sentences.t: 一些分析家認爲索馬里是非常失敗的國家。
sentences.en: Some analysts consider Somalia as the failed state par excellence.

sentences.s: 她的皮肤比雪还白。
sentences.t: 她的皮膚比雪還白。
sentences.en: Her skin is whiter than snow.

sentences.s: 把土豆切一下。
sentences.t: 把土豆切一下。
sentences.en: Cut the potatoes.

sentences.s: 那辆汽车大白天被人偷走了。
sentences.t: 那輛汽車大白天被人偷走了。
sentences.en: The car was stolen in broad daylight.

source.title: 大 TIME
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
sentences.t: 我自己能夠證實那是真的。
sentences.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.

sentences.s: 教育是国家的根本。
sentences.t: 教育是國家的根本。
sentences.en: Education is the foundation of the country.

source.title: 根本
source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 英语有很多法语外来词。
sentences.t: 英語有很多法語外來詞。
sentences.en: English has many loan words from French.

sentences.s: 我下个月要搬家，得赶快找房子。
sentences.t: 我下個月要搬家，得趕快找房子。
sentences.en: I have to move next month, I have to find housing quickly.

source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 两位学者为一句意思含糊的藏文句子争论了一番。
sentences.t: 兩位學者爲一句意思含糊的藏文句子爭論了一番。
sentences.en: The two scholars wrangled over the meaning of an obscure Tibetan phrase.

sentences.s: 你真的拥抱汤姆？
sentences.t: 你真的擁抱湯姆？
sentences.en: Did you really hug Tom?

sentences.s: 游泳锻炼肌肉。
sentences.t: 游泳鍛鍊肌肉。
sentences.en: Swimming develops your muscles.

sentences.s: 过了半天，脑子才清醒过来。
sentences.t: 過了半天，腦子才清醒過來。
sentences.en: My head cleared up only after a long time,

source.license: Language Player grammar chart (third-party course material)

sentences.s: 你不应该待在这里。
sentences.t: 你不應該待在這裏。
sentences.en: You're not supposed to be in this area.

sentences.s: 我的钱包和护照不见了。
sentences.t: 我的錢包和護照不見了。
sentences.en: My wallet and passport are missing.

sentences.s: 他们说情况只是暂时的。
sentences.t: 他們說情況只是暫時的。
sentences.en: They said the situation was only temporary.

sentences.s: 据说他很富有。
sentences.t: 據說他很富有。
sentences.en: They say that he is very rich.

sentences.s: 他讨厌打扫自己的房间。
sentences.t: 他討厭打掃自己的房間。
sentences.en: He hates cleaning his room.

sentences.s: 我们在藏着。
sentences.t: 我們在藏着。
sentences.en: We're hiding.

sentences.s: 你会陪我去吗？
sentences.t: 你會陪我去嗎？
sentences.en: Will you accompany me?

sentences.s: 令我非常伤心的是她考砸了。
sentences.t: 令我非常傷心的是她考砸了。
sentences.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.

们.m: plural marker for pronouns, and nouns referring to individuals

的.m: of; ~'s (possessive particle); (used after an attribute when it modifies a noun); (used at the end of a declarative sentence for emphasis); (used after a noun, verb or adjective to form a nominal expression, as in 皮革的 "one made of leather" or 跑堂儿的 "a waiter (literally, one who runs back and forth in a restaurant)" or 新的 "new one")

配.m: to join; to fit; to mate; to mix

备.m: (bound form) to prepare; to equip; (literary) fully; completely

了.m: (completed action marker); (modal particle indicating change of state, situation now); (modal particle intensifying preceding clause); to finish

调.m: to transfer; to move (troops or cadres); to investigate; to enquire into

无.m: used in 南无; not to have; no; none

法.m: France; French; abbr. for 法国; law

忍.m: to bear; to endure; to tolerate; to restrain oneself

受.m: to receive; to accept; to suffer; subjected to

在.m: to exist; to be alive; (of sb or sth) to be (located) at; (used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)

家.m: used in 家伙 and 家俱; home; family; (polite) my (sister, uncle etc)

靠.m: to lean against or on; to stand by the side of; to come near to; to depend on

父.m: (bound form) father; (bound form) male relative of father's generation (as in 伯父); (computing) (bound form) parent-

母.m: mother; elderly female relative; origin; source

出.m: to go out; to come out; to arise; to occur; to produce; to yield; to go beyond; to exceed

门.m: surname Men; gate; door; doorway; gateway; opening (CL:扇); valve; switch; other door-like or gate-like structure; way to do sth; knack; method; approach

他.m: (third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his; (bound form) other; another; some other (as in 他日 and 他人)

将.m: will; shall; to use; to take

要.m: (bound form) to demand; to coerce; to want; to need; to ask for; will; shall; about to; need to; should

觉.m: a nap; a sleep; to feel; to find that

一.m: one; single; a (article); as soon as

分.m: to divide; to separate; to distribute; to allocate; to distinguish (good and bad); (bound form) branch of (an organization); sub- (as in 分局)

钱.m: surname Qian; coin; money; unit of weight, one tenth of a tael 两

偷.m: to steal; (bound form) thief; (bound form) secretly; on the sly

走.m: to walk; to go; to run; to move (of vehicle)

大.m: big; large; great; older (than another person); eldest (as in 大姐); greatly; freely; fully

吧.m: bar (loanword) (serving drinks, or providing Internet access etc); to puff (on a pipe etc); (onom.) bang; abbr. for 贴吧

看.m: to look after; to take care of; to watch; to guard
